sourceDescription: NMC letter D-11011/500/2024-AcademicCell dated 12-09-2024 with CBME Curriculum 2024 and competency volumes; Pharmacology (CODE: PH) table read at text offsets 250000-350000 of 801400.
verification: Official NMC document text read through a web reader that quotes short rows and restates long rows. PDF bytes, the pinned SHA-256, sourceBodySha256 values, rendered pages and table-cell alignment were not independently verified. Identity of this file with the pinned source PDF is assumed from title and date, not proven. No source prose stored.
modeRule: Practical draft mode expected when the official level contains SH; knowledge mode otherwise. No exceptions needed.
scope: All 92 Pharmacology references in the index (PH1.1-PH10.17); none had selected review evidence at the checked head.
limits: Editorial scope comparison only; no clinical, prescribing, faculty, rights or canonical acceptance.
Drug names, regimens and programme guidance were not checked for currency.
The 154-reference original hold inventory is unchanged.
certificationCountReported values are reader-reported and need a rendered-page check before use.

rows.note: Level cell printed as "KH, C"; no SH, so knowledge draft mode accepted.
